newsitem.title: USA: ITT Corp Q2 oper shr $0.72 vs $0.78.
newsitem.headline: ITT Corp Q2 oper shr $0.72 vs $0.78.

text.p: (Figures in millions, except per share data)
NOTE: 1997 Q2 net excludes several one-time items and assets held for sale. The one-time items are:

1) An after-tax gain of $116 million ($200 million pre-tax) or $0.99 per share on the sale of a 39.8 percent interest in Madison Square Garden. Total pre-tax proceeds to ITT from the sale were $500 million.
2) An after-tax provision of $5.0 million ($9 million pre-tax) or $0.04 per share for costs associated with the hostile offer for the company by Hilton Hotels Corp.

3) After-tax earnings of $2 million ($4 million pre-tax) or $0.02 per share at the Desert Inn in Las Vegas and the company's riverboat casino in Tunica, Miss. ITT has decided to dispose of these properties and has reflected them as assets held for sale. The second quarter 1996 earnings for these properties and for ITT's stake in MST and WBIS-TV, which ITT has also agreed to sell, were $4.0 million ($6.0 million pre-tax) or $0.03 per share.
Earnings before interest, taxes and depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) for 1997 Q2 were $262 million vs $276 million.
Revenues for the 1997 Q2 exclude assets held for sale.
First Call mean estimate for 1997 Q2 EPS was $0.72.
